definitions.explanation: A work that continues or follows up on a previous work, such as a book, movie, game, or TV series.

examples.japanese: {続編|ぞくへん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to the sequel.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{続編|ぞくへん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The sequel to that movie will be released next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|だい}ヒット→大ヒット：20827_daihitto⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{続編|ぞくへん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{裏切|うらぎ}らない→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧⟦{出来|でき}→出来：11763_deki⟧だった。
examples.english: The sequel to the hugely popular novel lived up to expectations.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used for movies, novels, manga, anime, and video games. Can also refer to non-fiction sequels or follow-up reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {続編|ぞくへん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: a sequel comes out
- {続編|ぞくへん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{制作|せいさく}する→制作する：25535_seisakusuru⟧: to produce a sequel
- ⟦{待望|たいぼう}→待望：12545_taibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{続編|ぞくへん}: long-awaited sequel
- {続編|ぞくへん}⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧: sequel confirmed

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (continuation) is more casual and can refer to the continuation of anything, not just creative works. ⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧2⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (second installment) is a more neutral term. {続編|ぞくへん} specifically implies a new work that follows up on a previous one.
